question: Transmute can be activated from my hand. Can I activate transfigure from my hand in the same way?

expected.shortAnswer: No: transfigure works only if the permanent with it is on the battlefield, and it fetches only a creature.
expected.answer: Transfigure is similar to Transmute, though it can be activated only if the permanent with Transfigure is on the battlefield, and it can fetch only a creature.

whyHard: Transfigure looks like transmute, but it is activated from the battlefield and sacrifices the permanent.
